thread:
Tara: Quick request  need a localized + accessibility-first benchpack for the May launch. Deliverables: hero stat (wide), 4 social crops (X, LI, IG, story), animated SVG micro-interaction for the landing page, an SVG icon set (latency/cost/throughput), a one-slide PPTX for sales, and an A/B headline matrix for social tests. Can design take this?
Ethan: Yes. Any specific lead stat and voice?
Tara: Lead stat: median latency 68ms, p99 170ms, cost est. $0.069/1k tokens on Dedicated. Voice: concise, engineering-forward, non-hype. Keep hero headline <= 9 words.
Marta: Localization ask: provide separate text layers in Figma, manifest CSV with string_id, english_text, context. Need translations into JP/FR/DE/ES. Keep headlines adaptable to 75 chars.
Kai: Visual direction: minimal stat card + micro-sparkline + icon row. SVG interaction = count-up to median stat on scroll. No drop shadows, core palette only. Inter var for type. Exports: PNG wide 1200x675, square 1080x1080, story crop 1080x1920, GIF fallback 800x450, and a single-slide PPTX. SVGs must be optimized and accessible (title/desc tags).
Design-bot: New Figma file created by Ethan: "benchpack-localize-may" https://figma.com/file/localize-may node=21 (comments enabled).
Ethan: Timeline: first comps by Tue EOD, interactive SVG prototype Wed, final exports Thur EOD so Localization can start. Will drop drafts in Figma and tag folks.
Tara: CTA + UTM: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=bench_localize_may&utm_campaign=bench_localize_may. Inbound mapping: `source=bench_localize_may`, hidden field `bench_variant`, route leads to queue `bench-webinar`.
Ops: Confirmed routing. APAC -> apac-sdr, EMEA -> emea-sdr, else bench-webinar. Will add hidden fields to the form mapping.
Marta: Accessibility checklist: 4.5:1 contrast for body text, 3:1 for large display type allowed, keyboard focus for interactive SVG, provide alt/longdesc for all images, accessible PPTX (editable text, not rasterized). Please include alt text in manifest.
Kai: Noted. I'll add separate layers for alt text and longdesc IDs that map to manifest.csv.
Legal: Flag on phrasing  avoid absolutes like "fastest" or "cheapest". If using relative claims (e.g., "~50% lower"), include a footnote and link to the research CSV. Provide source link in asset pack.
Tara: Data CSV uploaded: https://drive.redwood/bench/bench_localize_may.csv and Research note: https://research.redwood/bench/analysis_may.md
Ethan: For A/B matrix: we'll produce 6 headline variants (3 short for X, 3 longer for LinkedIn) + recommended captions. Will include tracking tokens per variant in the manifest.
Marta: Also need cultural check for imagery in JP/DE—avoid location-specific landmarks. Localization will supply quick checks within 24h of finalizing copy.
Design-bot: Figma comment by Ethan on frame "Hero-interactive": "prototype v1 - includes SVG count-up and aria labels" https://figma.com/file/localize-may?node-id=21:40
Ethan: Deliverable package should include: manifest.csv (string IDs + alt text + file names), assets/ (PNGs, SVGs, GIFs), pptx/, svg-interactive/ (minified), research.csv, and a README.md with export notes. Drop into /marketing-assets/bench_localize_may after approvals.
Tara: Timeline recap: drafts Tue EOD, interactive Wed, final Thur EOD -> legal sweep Fri morning -> localization sign-off Fri afternoon -> scheduled posts Mon May 9 10:00 PT.
Legal: Will review copy in Figma once v1 is up; if claims require more substantiation we'll loop in Research. Footnote copy suggestion: "Benchmark compares Redwood Dedicated runtime to baseline models; see data."
Ethan: Accessibility test plan: keyboard nav, reduced-motion GIF fallback, color contrast checklist, screenreader readthrough of SVG title/desc. Will add a test report to the asset package.
Marta: Translation notes: provide context column in manifest and character limits. We'll return CSV with translations and review notes within 48h of final.
Kai: Small note  keep the hero copy in one line max for story crop; make sure the stat scales responsively.
Tara: Great. @Ethan please ping when v1 is in Figma. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
